import json, random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import gen, verify, brute, controller
from fractions import Fraction
bad=0; n=int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 200
for i in range(n):
    rng=random.Random(12345+i)
    c=gen.gen_case(rng, J=rng.randint(2,7), S=rng.randint(2,4), F=rng.randint(1,3), G=rng.randint(0,2), tmax=20)
    c['class_values']=[1]*7                      # every utility equal
    for w in c['windows']:
        w[6]=rng.choice([1,1,2])                 # few distinct priorities
        w[1]=rng.choice([0,5,10]); w[2]=rng.choice([10,20,30])
        if w[2]<w[1]: w[2]=w[1]
    for s in c['slots']:
        s[1]=rng.randint(1,3)
    req={'version':3,'cases':[c]}
    resp=controller.run(json.dumps(req).encode())
    try:
        verify.check_request(req,resp)
        r=resp['results'][0]
        preds=controller._predict(c['model'],c['windows'],c['flows'])
        br=brute.best(c,preds)
        got=(Fraction(r['ratio'][0],r['ratio'][1]), r['utility'], r['age'])
        if got!=br:
            bad+=1; print('MISMATCH',i,got,br, json.dumps(c)[:300])
    except Exception as e:
        bad+=1; print('FAIL',i,type(e).__name__,str(e)[:150])
    if bad>5: break
print('tie trials',n,'bad',bad)
PYEOF
